formal: Pass the Cyber Resilience Examination (minimum 75% score)

plus.note: Bridges cybersecurity and business continuity disciplines.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 3. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Japanese availability and cyber-continuity integration offer a useful resilience baseline, but open entry and a multiple-choice-only exam do not establish the experience required for applied practitioner responsibility.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The proctored exam establishes entry knowledge linking cyber resilience and continuity. With no experience prerequisite and limited recognition, the Associate title does not demonstrate associate delivery responsibility.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded cyber-resilience bridge introduces useful continuity and security concepts without an experience requirement. A multiple-choice exam and limited outside recognition do not establish associate operational delivery merely through the title.
